title: Attempt to export an empty dashboard as a PDF
steps: Open the Share menu on the empty dashboard.
Invoke Export as PDF if it is offered as an executable action.

video_guide.summary: The empty dashboard's Share menu has no Export as PDF entry.

chapters.label: Inspect Share on the empty dashboard

chapters.note: Share is open on the empty dashboard; its entries do not include Export as PDF.
The menu remains open with no PDF export entry or download notification.
